class_id: card asserts a false fact about the code, builder patches around it
feature: docs/design/build-cards/** consumed by an implementation worker
symptom: a build card states a factual claim about this codebase — a function, a feature flag, a file, a heading, a dependency or a count — that is not true, and the worker silently builds around it instead of correcting the card, so the card keeps asserting the false fact to the next reader and the design and the code drift apart with nothing recording that they did
